nodes.label:
New Laptop Imaged
and Configured
nodes.title: Device Imaging Process
nodes.info: Applying one known-good software image to every club laptop so all of them start identical, with the same accounts, tools, and restrictions, instead of being set up one at a time by hand.

nodes.label: Apply Label
nodes.title: Device Labeling System
nodes.info: A durable visible identifier on each machine that matches its inventory record, so any laptop can be tied to its history without opening it.

nodes.label:
Add to Inventory
Record
nodes.title: Device Inventory Tracking
nodes.info: The record for each machine: its identifier, purchase date, current condition, and who has it. Without it a fleet is a pile of laptops, not an asset.

nodes.label:
Store in
Charging Cart
nodes.title: Device Charging Cart
nodes.info: Laptops live in a lockable cart that charges them between sessions, so the fleet is always ready and always accounted for at the end of the night.

nodes.label:
Leaving the
Building?
nodes.title: Leaving the Building?
nodes.info: Whether a laptop stays on club premises for in-session use or goes home with a student determines whether a loaner agreement is required.

nodes.label:
Sign Loaner
Agreement
nodes.title: Device Loaner Agreement
nodes.info: A signed agreement covering what the machine may be used for, who is responsible for damage, and when it comes back. Required before any laptop leaves the building.

nodes.label: Used In-Session
nodes.title: Used In-Session
nodes.info: The laptop stays on club premises, is used during the session, and returns to the cart at the end without any paperwork beyond the inventory record.

nodes.label: Laptop Returned
nodes.title: Laptop Returned
nodes.info: The laptop comes back at the end of a session or a loan period, and its condition is checked before it re-enters storage.

nodes.label: Condition Check
nodes.title: Condition Check
nodes.info: A mentor inspects the returned laptop for anything beyond normal wear before deciding its next step.

nodes.label:
Run Cleaning
Routine
nodes.title: Device Cleaning Routine
nodes.info: Wipe the screen and keyboard, clear the student's session data, confirm the charge, and return it to the cart. This is the path most laptops take, most weeks.

nodes.label:
Attempt Basic
Repair
nodes.title: Device Repair Basics
nodes.info: Reseating a battery, replacing a key cap, clearing a stuck port -- fixes inside a mentor's safe boundary. Resolved machines rejoin the cart.

nodes.label:
Flag for
Outside Repair
nodes.title: Flag for Outside Repair
nodes.info: Damage beyond a mentor's safe repair boundary is logged in the inventory as out of service and sent to a manufacturer or repair shop -- a path Chapter 23 continues with device end-of-life planning.
